{"reason": "v1 pays 45000 to switch suppliers even at 10–13 inventory-days where monitor is safe (regular-lead<=8), and stocks out at 2.8 days where only the planner arrives in time. Edit: split the switch branch — rebalance (6000, transfer 2–4d) for 5–9 days, monitor above; extend the planner alert to medium risk <5 days, keeping stockouts from rising.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 9))
     (list 'propose-internal-rebalance))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
